reviews.comment: The most outstanding thing about this professor is how passionate he is about diff eq, and he cares a lot about his students. Although I didn't end the semester understanding too much about differential equations, I knew how to solve them well enough. Also, he provides practice tests that are very similar to the exams.
He clearly loves mathematics and cares about his students. I would recommend him to anyone.

I started this class not understanding what was going on at all. I was confused in every lecture. Professor Janssens took feedback from students and started to focus more on examples than theory, which helped a lot. Homework is difficult, but exams are exactly like the practice exams so they aren't difficult. Cool guy, would take again.

At first lectures were quite theory heavy then switched to mostly examples. There's not a lot of hw but it's challenging, with a focus on theory. HW doesn't really prepare you for the tests but they're very similar to the sample tests he that he gives. He's a nice guy and pretty reasonable so I wouldn't worry too much about this class
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take him even if you've taken 308 before. My grade right now is very low, considering I've gotten A's on all my exams. He grades homework super tough and gives no partial credit. When I asked him about the grading, he took no feedback and said, "The prof gets to decide the grading rubric". Very not understanding person and won't hear you out.

Professor Janssens is new professor to Texas A&M. He is a very kind professor and is very approachable to ask questions. The material in differential equation is difficult, however professor Janssens improved his class by taking more feedback from the students and improving the practice tests to make them almost exactly like the test.

First year teacher. Focused much too heavily on theory instead of examples, which made the homework difficult to understand. Tests are completely different from week in reviews and other professors. You will have to teach everything to yourself to pass. He also gives a ton of python HW for no reason and then grades it harshly. Avoid at all costs
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: New to teaching and lectures more for theory, but if you do the readings and practice problems, maybe even suppliment with youtube you will do fine. He is very lenient in grading and the practice tests are VERY similar to the actual exams. Super nice and more than wiling to help (math isn't my strong suit at all and he helped me with accomodations)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He was okay. Class was very tough and the homework assignments tended to be very difficult. Thankful that he provided good exam reviews. Seems like a new prof, will probably be better in the future after some time understanding how students think.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things
